title: Checkout & Payment
description: The subscription purchase path, end to end: pick a plan, choose how long, apply a loyalty coupon, then pay. One price engine drives every screen, so redeeming a coupon re-prices the plan cards, the duration rows and the bottom dock together, and the member's tier badge rides the discount all the way to the payment sheet. Coupons above the member's rung render locked, which is what makes the loyalty ladder legible at the moment of purchase. Payment fields are prototype UI on mock data — nothing is ever charged.

entries.note: THE FIRST ENTRY POINT (Rashid, 2026-09-12): home → the coupon flow → checkout. rewards emits {t:'ds-nav', to:'checkout', present:'sheet', context:{src:'rewards', coupon:<code>}} and checkout opens on the plan picker with that coupon already applied and every price re-priced. The code is validated the same way a redemption is; an unrecognised one is ignored rather than poisoning state, so this degrades quietly until rewards emits.

Boots the signed-out plan picker on mock data. Every param is an optional override, never a dependency: 'plan' preselects a card, 'tier' sets the loyalty rung that gates the coupon wallet, and entry=renew opens straight into the tiered Renew Plan durations. Also accepted as a ctx JSON blob or a {t:'ds-context'} postMessage.
The loyalty-page route: a member tapping Checkout lands on their plan's duration list with the tier already applied.

exits.note: The coupon button and the promo bar both summon the rewards flow to redeem — context {src:'checkout', mode:'redeem', tier}. EXPECTS A RESULT BACK: {t:'ds-result', from:'rewards', payload:{code}} where code is rewards' own coupon code (DS-<TIER>25 / GYM-<TIER> / KIDS-<TIER>). Checkout decodes the code, applies the discount and re-prices; an unknown code is ignored.

handoff.Frames built: Subscribe Modal · Duration Select (default plans) · Level 8 / Renew Plan · Modify Default Plan Modal · Payment options (Visa) · Promo Code (applied + empty)
handoff.Price engine: list = duration.was · subtotal = duration.now · − coupon (flat KD, or percentage capped at coupon.cap) · − method delta · = total. Savings shown = list − total.
handoff.Coupon tiers: bronze → silver → gold → VIP. A coupon is selectable only when its tier rank ≤ the member's rank; downgrading the member drops an now-locked applied coupon automatically.
handoff.Tier badge: Applied coupons wear the Figma green chip with the tier name. Inside the wallet each coupon wears its tier's own Figma badge gradient, matched to the rewards flow (section 17137:76380).
handoff.Screen motion: push = translateX(100%) → 0 over 420ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), outgoing screen parks at −26%. Sheets = translateY(100%) → 0 over 460ms on the same curve.
handoff.Glass: Nav buttons and the coupon FAB use CSS backdrop-filter (blur 14 / saturate 180) rather than liquid-glass-js: they float over live scrolling content, which the shader's frozen page snapshot cannot track. Native equivalent is .glassEffect().
handoff.Payment: PROTOTYPE UI ONLY — mock data, no processing, no card entry, nothing charged. Pay Now raises a confirmation toast.
handoff.Driving it from a script: See the Semantic control map (controls[]) for every act and its payload — one delegated listener on [data-act] at the phone root, authored from the dispatcher. Labels are split across weight spans for typography and must never be matched on. For most runs you can skip the tapping entirely: ?ctx={"entry":…,"screen":…,"tier":…,"plan":…,"coupon":…} boots straight into any state, which is how this flow was verified on device when the Simulator MCP refused tap injection.
handoff.Open question — dock arithmetic: Figma's dock reads Before KD139 → KD96 on every checkout frame while its own duration rows read KD149 → KD98 (and 149 − 98 = the Save KD51 badge). The two cannot both be right; the engine follows the self-consistent rows. Needs Rashid's call.
handoff.Open question — confirmation: No confirmation/receipt frame exists in the Figma section. Pay Now currently ends in a toast.
handoff.Open question — duration list: The default-plans frame draws '1 Month' twice at KD99.500 and KD99; built verbatim, but it reads like unfinished placeholder copy.
handoff.Coupons: ONE coupon experience in the product: the rewards flow. Checkout keeps no catalogue — it summons rewards and decodes the code that comes back, so the tier travels inside the code (DS-VIP25 → vip, 25% capped KD 80). The lab menu's Redeemed-coupon picker is review chrome standing in for the rip, not product surface.
handoff.Overlay: The plan picker is how checkout arrives, so it follows system/overlays.html: scrim rgba(11,14,18,.42) opacity-only over .32s ease (the scrim never travels — it dissolves in place, only the sheet moves), sheets translateY(103%)→0 on .55s cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), partial sheets 24 24 0 0, the near-fullscreen plan overlay 44 44 0 0, lift 0 -14px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.24). NOTE: that radius overrides the 38 the Figma frame draws — the same frame-vs-law tension recorded against auth; resolved here on Rashid's instruction to apply the system values.
handoff.Tier is global: The member's tier is NOT checkout's to own. It lives in localStorage under `ds-tier-v1` (values: bronze|silver|gold|vip), seeded on first boot, written by the lab picker, by a redemption proving a higher rung, and by an incoming ctx.tier. A `storage` listener applies a change made in another flow without a reload. Any flow that shows tier should read the same key — Rashid, 2026-09-12: set a tier once and it applies throughout the prototype. The badge wears its own rung using the Figma tier gradients (17137:76380), matching how rewards themes its coupons.
handoff.Glass CTAs: Book Consultation and Guide me are house glass widgets in light-mode form — the home flow's .plancard material (white .7 / blur 14 / saturate 140, .5px hairline, 0 8px 37px lift). The brand CTA wears the same shell with its gradient as a tint BENEATH the glass and a thinner white fill (.22) so the primary action keeps its weight.
